as_told.title: Descartes as a Jesuit agent setting up a mechanistic paradigm to keep the occult under church authority

plain: The French philosopher René Descartes is said to have been an agent of the Jesuits, a Catholic religious order, sent to infiltrate the Rosicrucians, a secretive mystical brotherhood of his time. The philosopher Jason Jorjani makes this argument on two episodes, drawing on his own book Prometheus and Atlas. In the second telling he puts the mission differently: Descartes, he says, set up "this extremely reductionistic mechanistic scientific paradigm" to keep everything occult under the church's control. If true, it would mean modern science's narrow view of the world was shaped on purpose to hide hidden knowledge.
